model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the values of two different network types, labeled "中介语网络" and "随机网络," across a series of categorical stages. The y-axis is also unlabeled, features a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 5.5, and has tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. The line representing "中介语网络" is red with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at 3.254 at A1, increases slightly to 3.278 at A2, dips to a local minimum of 3.179 at B1, and subsequently follows an upward trend through 3.235 at B2, 3.304 at C1, and 3.420 at C2, concluding at its highest point of 3.685 at "母语".
